1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein __the cooling system is specifically configured for installation within standard residential wall construction and is not a general-purpose evaporative cooling device applicable to any indoor area__.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

3. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately__ twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Original) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through __an outlet opening in the housing__.

7. (Original) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

8. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Original) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes __a removable__ front cover.

12. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is __a load-bearing wall of a residential structure__.

14. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1 ; mounting elements __including fasteners for securing the housing between wall studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Original) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.
